text: Session-start sweep ratification (2026-05-16): most recent comment (2026-05-14, >24h ago, no human reply) ends with 'Recommendation: (a) — pair with JMAP-wlip.30 and JMAP-wlip.35 in a single major-bump propagation pass.'
